name: Saudi Motorsport Company (SMC)
via: operates under SAMF and the Ministry of Sport
note: Founded 2021 as the dedicated entity for promoting and operating motorsport in Saudi Arabia in line with Vision 2030; chaired by HRH Prince Khalid bin Sultan Al-Abdullah Al-Faisal, who also chairs SAMF. Its own site says it operates under SAMF and the Ministry of Sport, so the state link is direct.
